content.title: About
content.content: Strawberry milk, whole, is a beverage made from whole cow's milk blended with natural strawberry puree and a touch of sugar. It has a smooth creamy base with a bright berry flavor and retains all the nutrients of whole milk.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Strawberry milk is often served in schools and day‑care centers as a tasty way to increase milk consumption.
The strawberries used provide vitamin C and antioxidants that boost immunity.
In some countries it is a traditional summer refresher.
Only natural puree is used to achieve the vivid pink color, without artificial dyes.
Whole milk typically contains about 3.5 % fat.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Strawberry milk retains the full calcium content of whole milk, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Milk supplies riboflavin (B2) and cobalamin (B12), supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Vitamin C from strawberries
items.content: The strawberry puree adds vitamin C, enhancing the drink's antioxidant capacity.

items.title: Protein
items.content: A serving provides about 8 g of high‑quality protein for growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Probiotics (when cultured)
items.content: If the milk is pasteurized with live cultures, it can help maintain a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People who are lactose intolerant should choose lactose‑free versions or limit intake.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein or whey can cause reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: The added sugar increases calorie content; those monitoring blood sugar should account for it.

items.title: Strawberry acidity
items.content: Children with sensitive stomachs may experience mild discomfort from the fruit's acidity.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink it chilled as a refreshing beverage, blend it into smoothies, add to cereals, desserts, or use as a base for fruit cocktails.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 1‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Do not freeze, as it may alter texture.
